CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.async_snapshot_valid(v jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$select v is not null and v->>'schema'='ldm.combat.snapshot' and coalesce((v->>'schemaVersion')::int,0)=1 and jsonb_typeof(v->'battle')='object'$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.async_store(p_request uuid, p_operation text, p_response jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$begin insert into public.async_requests(user_id,request_id,operation,response) values(auth.uid(),p_request,p_operation,p_response) on conflict(user_id,request_id) do nothing; return p_response; end$function$
functions.args: p_request uuid, p_operation text, p_response jsonb
functions.name: async_store
